text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile Championship. Thanks 
to the Trainer's hard work, a massive 
crowd has packed into the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals gathered at the racecourse as 
well. Their presence, along with her 
Trainer's, pushed Daiichi Ruby to even 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The supreme stage is set. Expressing her 
gratitude to her Trainer, Daiichi Ruby 
heads toward the race. To radiate the 
ultimate brilliance, she runs with 
elegance now—!
